method: top-down TAM, bottom-up SAM, SOM 3% of SAM in 2 years

inputs.name: active registered vehicles in the UAE (June 2025)
inputs.source: Salik / The National, May 2025: 4.56 million active registered vehicles (thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2025/05/13/dubais-salik-reports-9-more-vehicles-on-the-roads-as-profits-soar)

inputs.name: share of active registered vehicles in the UAE (June 2025) that would buy
inputs.source: assumption: about half of UAE drivers use a windshield sunshade in summer heat; check with a 50-person survey

inputs.name: spend a year each
inputs.source: assumption: one AED 130-150 custom shade replaced roughly every 14 months

inputs.name: Patrol, Land Cruiser and Hilux on UAE roads
inputs.source: assumption: three top-10 models (2025 sales: Hilux ~19,140, Patrol ~16,790 per autopunditz.com/post/uae-car-market-2025-toyota-jetour-t2-sales) at ~5% share each over ~10 years of the 4.56M fleet

inputs.name: shades a year per customer
inputs.source: assumption: half of owners buy a new shade each year (first purchase or replacement)

inputs.name: price per shade
inputs.source: assumption: launch price at the custom-fit band seen on UAE stores, AED 130-222 (desertcart.ae, carrefouruae.com listings)

inputs.name: Custom-fit sunshade price band, UAE stores
inputs.source: Proadsy Camry AED 140, Arismotor Land Cruiser/Navigator ~AED 133, Galaxy Auto Shield AED 222 (desertcart.ae, carrefouruae.com)

formulas.tam: 4,560,000 active registered vehicles in the UAE (June 2025) x 50% x AED 110 = AED 250,800,000
formulas.sam: 250,000 Patrol, Land Cruiser and Hilux on UAE roads x 0.5 shades a year x AED 149 = AED 18,625,000

som_reason: Owners of Patrol, Land Cruiser and Hilux who now buy loose universal shades (AED 57-69) or no exact fit switch to a shade cut for their exact model year, found by searching their model name on Amazon.ae; a model-specific listing with a fit video wins that search
